key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran military strikes and Strait of Hormuz shipping blockade driving oil prices sharply higher
reasoning: Despite a very bullish CPI print that crushed rate-hike expectations, QQQ closed flat as escalating US-Iran tensions and IBM's 26% crash offset the good news. The market's inability to rally on strong macro data signals underlying fragility, and with oil surging above $86 on a shipping blockade, overnight gap-down risk is material.
